thread:
rachel.m: Hi all  I'm likely to start parental leave next week due to an unexpected NICU stay. I have three quick asks: 1) can payroll pause any automatic equity vesting transfers during leave? 2) who do I notify about laptop access and office badge return if leave becomes extended? 3) can I request an emergency child care reimbursement while Im on leave?
people-ops: So sorry to hear that, Rachel . Quick answers: 1) Vesting continues per plan unless you request a formal pause; we can coordinate with Equity to process a short suspension if medically required. Send us an email to benefits@redwood.com and well pull the Equity team in. 2) Badge/laptop: if you need someone to collect equipment we can arrange via Facilities/IT. You dont need to return the laptop immediately if its needed for occasional check-ins; just let us know whether it stays with you. 3) Emergency childcare: we have a one-time emergency reimbursement (up to $1,000) for verified care during medical parental events. Submit receipts to expenses.redwood.com and tag "Emergency childcare".
payroll-bot: Note: payroll cannot arbitrarily pause equity vesting; Equity admin requires signed medical leave paperwork. Upload medical cert or hospital letter to https://benefits.redwood.com/leave-forms -> choose "Medical documentation". For top-up: to receive Redwood pay-top-up, SDI must be submitted and the EDD determination uploaded.
lisa.manager: Rachel, I can cover your on-call rotation and shadow the handover today. Also, if you want a formal pause on project reviews, say the word and Ill defer deadlines. Take the time you need.
it-support: If you want IT to pick up hardware, open a ticket at https://it.redwood.com/requests with subject "Equipment pickup - parental leave" and include building location. We can coordinate a contactless pickup. If you plan to return part-time, we can provision restricted access: e.g., SSH read-only and no prod deploy keys.
security: Heads up: if laptop leaves country or NICU location introduces privacy concerns, refrain from accessing any PHI data stored locally. If you need access to Redwood systems from hospital networks, we'll whitelist specific IPs after review.
rachel.m: Thank you everyone  Ill upload the hospital note today. Quick follow-up: can I defer my all-hands presentation scheduled in two weeks?
people-ops: Yes, well mark it deferred. Also filing note: to guarantee payroll top-up alignment, docs should be in the portal by the last day of the pay period that contains your first paid leave day. If timeline is tight, flag "expedite" in the upload comment.
rachel.m: Got it. One last thing  if I return at 60% FTE for 8 weeks, will benefits/prorated salary change?
people-ops: Medical and dental remain active during paid parental leave. If you switch to an approved part-time schedule after return, payroll will prorate salary starting on the effective date; benefits eligibility continues if you remain in a benefits-eligible role. Well send a confirmation email with exact prorated amounts once youve picked dates.
lisa.manager: Also, for continuity Ill create a short runbook and pin it to the team channel. Rachel, if youre comfortable, add a single-page "must know" note before you go. No pressure.
rachel.m: Thank you all. Uploading docs now and I appreciate the support
